wythoff.name: List the Conway operators for lots of examples of the constructive notation
Wythoff equivalents to |pqr, p|qr, pq|r, pqr|, for (2 3 5). The — wythoff -M -p [VEF]0V,0E,0F,0V0E0F schwarz_2_3_5p
Wythoff equivalents to |pqr, p|qr, pq|r, pqr|, for (2 3 5). The base model — wythoff -M -p [V]0E,0F schwarz_2_3_5p
Wythoff equivalents to |pqr, p|qr, pq|r, pqr|, for (2 3 5). The base — wythoff -M -p [VE]0V,0E,0v0e schwarz_2_3_5p
Wythoff equivalents to |pqr, p|qr, pq|r, pqr|, for (2 3 5). The — wythoff -M -p [VEF]0v0e,0e0f,0f0v schwarz_2_3_5p
By default a polyhedron is processed by the Conway 'meta' operation before applying the constructive notation. Here is…
If the base polyhedron is already like a meta tiling, i.e. 2-colourable triangle faces and even order vertices, then it…
Models may be coloured using the colours from the base model, in this example the faces of a dodecahedron are coloured…
wythoff.command: off_color -f U dod | wythoff -c p -C a | wythoff -c o_4 -C a | off_util -S
